name: Rakshita Nalwaya
title: Technical Product Manager
tagline: Product leader at the intersection of AI, fintech, and platform strategy, turning complex workflows into scalable, data-driven products.
about: I am a Technical Product Manager with a computer science foundation and 6+ years of experience spanning fintech, CRM platforms, and enterprise risk management. At Ygrene Energy Fund, I own product strategy for automation, portal modernization, and sales analytics delivering measurable impact including 30% faster underwriting and 25% higher user satisfaction. Previously at Bank of America, I progressed from CRM Data Analyst managing Salesforce infrastructure for 30,000+ users to Risk Management Associate, leading risk remediation and disaster recovery across 10+ applications. I combine hands-on AI implementation with cross-functional leadership, from LLM-powered applications to enterprise platform rollouts. Selected for Cornell Johnson's Digital Technology Immersion Program, I am actively exploring roles where product vision meets applied AI and data-driven decision making.
